column1: # family | composition/viewpoint | color/edges/depth | failures/conflicts | budget emphasis

photography|Choose a camera position that explains the subject; preserve believable focal length, occlusion and depth of field|Organize exposure and white balance; edges follow focus and motion, not arbitrary outlines|Painterly edges, plastic surfaces, impossible reflections and uniform sharpness conflict with optical evidence|Spend tokens on subject, light source, lens behavior and material response before retouch language

cinematic-film-still|Stage a decisive supplied moment with readable blocking, motivated framing and layered planes|Unify tonal grade while retaining local color; foreground occlusion and focus guide attention|Invented narrative events, gratuitous anamorphic flare and crushed blacks obscure the brief|Prioritize action, blocking, camera placement and motivated light over generic film adjectives

illustration|Make the supplied idea legible through silhouette, grouping and selective exaggeration|Let contour, flat shape and chosen marks organize space; color relationships support meaning|Generic digital gloss, indiscriminate detail and unrelated symbolism weaken authored visual decisions|Describe shape and mark grammar before decorative detail

fine-art-traditional-media|Compose for the physical support and selected mark scale; preserve focal structure|Specify how pigment, binder and support produce edges, transparency, impasto or grain|A digital filter cannot substitute for authentic deposition; incompatible wet/dry techniques need explicit intent|Name medium behavior and focal marks before optional support texture

3d-cgi|Use consistent camera projection and modeled scale; maintain contact and occlusion|Describe roughness, transmission and specularity separately; edges and subdivision follow construction|Melted geometry, floating joints and contradictory reflections break modeled coherence|Prioritize volume, material response and light geometry

graphic-design|Use grid, alignment, margins and hierarchy to communicate supplied content|Color and shape encode roles; depth is optional and must not compete with hierarchy|Unrequested copy, pseudo-text and ornamental clutter damage communication|Prioritize information order, spacing and exact supplied text

vector-flat-art|Build the scene with deliberate paths, overlap and shape economy|Use clean contour and controlled fill relationships; depth comes from plane overlap|Photographic texture, accidental gradients and tangled paths conflict with vector clarity|Prioritize silhouette, path behavior and fill hierarchy

cartoon-animation|Stage readable poses with clear action lines and balanced exaggeration|Group values and shape families; retain consistent contour and character construction|Fused limbs, off-model shapes and arbitrary detail weaken animation readability|Prioritize pose, expression when relevant, silhouette and controlled shape language

comic-sequential-art|Choose one supplied story beat or explicit panel sequence; keep action and reading order clear|Ink weights, shadow masses and screen texture define depth and emphasis|Invented speech, extra panels and confusing action continuity obscure the request|Prioritize moment, panel organization, contour hierarchy and exact requested lettering

anime-manga|Use designed silhouettes, expressive staging and consistent anatomy for the supplied subject|Cel planes or ink/screentone must match the exact substyle; backgrounds support focal forms|Automatic human characters, mismatched rendering and inconsistent facial construction are not style fidelity|Prioritize contour design, value grouping and subject-specific stylization

concept-art|Choose views that explain design function and scale; detail resolves the focal proposition|Value masses and selective material indications communicate construction|Polished spectacle without design logic, impossible mechanisms and unrelated world-building are weak|Prioritize functional silhouette and construction before finish

fantasy|Keep supplied imaginative rules legible through scale, staging and coherent relationships|Ground extraordinary forms in consistent material and lighting behavior|Automatic magic, medieval scenery or invented characters change intent|Prioritize the specified extraordinary relationship and its physical presentation

sci-fi-futuristic|Explain supplied technology through coherent modules, access and scale|Separate manufactured surfaces, interfaces and emission with consistent light response|Random greebles, neon and pseudo-labels do not establish technological function|Prioritize functional construction and exact era/subgenre grammar

architecture-interior|Preserve layout, circulation, structural proportions and camera geometry|Use coherent material junctions, verticals and window-to-interior exposure|Impossible supports, warped rooms and invented floor plans misrepresent the design|Prioritize spatial organization, construction and light paths

product-commercial|Choose a view that reveals accurate silhouette and defining construction|Controlled reflection shapes and contact shadows communicate finish without altering color|Invented brands, misleading proportions and blown highlights weaken product fidelity|Prioritize product identity, material response and useful detail

infographic-educational|Arrange supplied facts into sequence, comparison or functional relationships|Use a consistent symbol grammar, alignment and color role; keep leaders unambiguous|Fabricated data, unsupported causal claims and pseudo-text are unacceptable|Prioritize information correctness, relational structure and exact labels

coloring-page-line-art|Keep margins, enclosed regions and readable overlaps appropriate to intended complexity|Use distinct black contours on a plain light field; no tonal fills unless explicitly required|Broken outlines, gray shading and tiny accidental regions defeat colorability|Prioritize enclosure, line weight, count and printable spacing

pixel-art|Choose a consistent pixel grid and readable cluster scale|Use discrete color ramps, purposeful stepping and selective dithering|Smooth interpolation, mixed resolution and random pixel noise contradict the medium|Prioritize cluster design, palette roles and silhouette

isometric|Maintain one parallel projection with shared axes and consistent scale|Plane values and occlusion explain depth without vanishing-point convergence|Mixed camera systems or inconsistent axis slopes destroy spatial coherence|Prioritize projection, footprint, contacts and plane hierarchy

low-poly-voxel-game-stylized|Make silhouette and spatial use readable at the intended game scale|Use the exact selected geometry system: facets, cubes or stylized meshes; keep material hierarchy simple|Mixing voxel and polygon rules or noisy detail obscures construction|Prioritize geometric grammar and action-readable form

paper-craft-handmade|Show how material pieces join, fold, overlap and support the supplied form|Edges, seams, fibers and thickness create tactile depth under suitable light|Seamless plastic, impossible folds and texture pasted across joins betray the medium|Prioritize construction evidence and material-specific surface behavior

icon-ui-asset|Design for small-size recognition, optical balance and clear safe margins|Use consistent stroke, fill or volumetric grammar for the exact icon type|Tiny text, busy scenery and unequal stroke weight reduce utility|Prioritize silhouette, internal gaps and compact recognition anchors

pattern-decorative|Establish repeat unit, interval and motif hierarchy across the field|Use consistent motif scale and edge continuation with a controlled surface treatment|Random placement, unintended seams and excessive focal variation break repetition|Prioritize repeat structure and motif relationships

abstract-experimental|Make the selected process or relationship observable through hierarchy and rhythm|Shape, light, surface and mark behavior must obey the chosen abstraction|Random decoration, literal benchmark objects and undifferentiated noise weaken intent|Prioritize process-specific evidence rather than invented narrative

retro-vintage|Use one coherent period vocabulary for layout and reproduction|Distinguish print, photographic and early digital behavior; aging remains subordinate|Mixed eras, compulsory palettes and fake historical text are misleading|Prioritize period shape and reproduction grammar over damage

minimal-clean|Retain every required element while reducing incidental competition|Use deliberate negative space, precise edges and restrained tonal hierarchy|Removing invariants or flattening all material differences is not useful minimalism|Prioritize placement, proportion and essential distinctions

surreal-dreamlike|Make the supplied impossible relationship deliberate while preserving local coherence|Use consistent rendering and selective perceptual uncertainty rather than universal blur|Accidental geometry errors, invented symbolism and lost counts are not dream logic|Prioritize the exact paradox and readable anchors

map-spatial-illustration|Preserve topology, adjacency, route continuity and supplied geographic hierarchy|Use a consistent symbol key, scale treatment and relief convention|Invented places, false connections and meaningless labels undermine spatial communication|Prioritize topology and exact supplied names before ornament
